question: What products and services do you offer?
answer: We offer a curated range of products and services. Browse the product catalog for current availability and full descriptions; items can change over time.

question: Where can I find product prices?
answer: Current prices are shown on each product page. Any applicable taxes or delivery charges are shown before you confirm an order.

question: What delivery options do you offer and how long do they take?
answer: We offer standard delivery, which generally takes 3–5 business days, and express delivery, which is typically faster. Delivery estimates are confirmed at checkout and may vary by destination.

question: How much does delivery cost?
answer: Standard delivery is free for eligible orders. Express delivery charges depend on the selected service and destination; the exact amount is displayed at checkout.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Eligible unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from your account or contact support for help; some item types may have exclusions.

question: How long do refunds take?
answer: After a returned item is received and approved, refunds are usually processed within 5–10 business days. Your bank or payment provider may take additional time to post the credit.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit and debit cards and PayPal. Available methods are shown securely at checkout; never send payment-card details through chat or email.

question: How do I manage or recover my account?
answer: Sign in to update your account details. If you forgot your password, use the password-reset link on the sign-in page. Support will never ask you to disclose your password.

question: When is customer support available?
answer: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM local time. Messages sent outside these hours will be reviewed on the next business day.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@example.com, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM local time. Please do not include passwords or full payment-card details in your message.
